notes.title: REMIMORY's next project is called RemiLore!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
Thank you for playing and supporting Color Symphony series.
Today, we are here to announce the development of next project called 'RemiLore'.
We know this is Color Symphony community and the game isn't exactly next Color Symphony project, but we wanted to share the news here so that you guys know what we are making next.
The next game is called 'RemiLore' and it is hack and slash type action rogue-lite game set in the world of Lore. Please check out the announcement trailer and home page of RemiLore.

[url]www.remilore.com[/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pHxdYA5Z3AY

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6811183/d835b0c410eca095158fd89d5c27bff3afbc08f4.jpg[/img]

We are developing RemiLore with another indie game developer Pixellore so check his game out too!

[url]www.pixellore.com[/url]
[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/340490/[/url]

Thank you very much!

notes.title: Color Symphony 2 is in development!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
Thank you again for enjoying and supporting Color Symphony.
Today, we are here to announce the development of Color Symphony 2.
The sequel is currently in development and expected to be released in the second half of this year. We are doing our best to provide you a great game.
Also, Color Symphony 2 is currently on Steam Greenlight, so hustle over and give it a vote if you are interested.
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=450216306
For more information on Color Symphony 2, check the Steam Greenlight page or the REMIMORY Facebook page.
Thank you.
